column_notes.trace_id: OTLP id; trace_rowid elsewhere is the internal row id

spans.promoted_columns_note: Prefer llm_token_count_* over JSON for per-span tokens; never SUM cumulative_* across spans. Promotion happens only when span_kind='LLM': a span of any other kind that carries llm.token_count.* in attributes has NULL in these columns and in cumulative_*, so a total over a whole project can undercount unless the JSON is consulted for non-LLM kinds.

column_notes.parent_id: the parent's span_id, not spans.id; self-join on span_id
column_notes.span_id: OTLP id, unique; the value parent_id points at
column_notes.trace_rowid: internal row id; traces.trace_id is the OTLP one

column_notes.span_start_time: copied from spans.start_time so cost can be filtered by time alone

column_notes.is_prompt: true for input tokens, false for output

span_cost_details.grain: One token-cost category within a span cost

column_notes.session_id: external id; project_sessions.id is the internal row id

dataset_example_revisions.grain: One immutable revision of a dataset example
